verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents an AI Assistant chat for planning/prioritizing/optimizing schedules, a Schedule Assistant that 'highlights what needs attention and suggests what to do next', and automatic time analytics across meetings/tasks/work-life balance — all AI-generated insights derived from the user's calendar data inside the product.  Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the insight quality, and more detail on the analytics/insights UI beyond marketing copy.
